description: This file implements the core logic for a shared storage plugin using JSON-RPC, managing storage via methods like setValue, getValue, deleteKey, and namespace management, with registration and unregistration of endpoints.

classes.name: SharedStorage
classes.description: Class managing shared storage operations with JSON-RPC endpoints, including registration, key-value manipulation, namespace management, and cache/limits handling.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers all JSON-RPC endpoints for storage operations.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters all JSON-RPC endpoints for storage operations.

methods.name: endpoint_setValue
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the storage under a specified scope.

methods.name: endpoint_getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a key from storage.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteKey
methods.description: Deletes a key from the storage.

methods.name: endpoint_deleteNamespace
methods.description: Deletes an entire namespace from storage.

methods.name: endpoint_getKeys
methods.description: Retrieves all keys within a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSize
methods.description: Deprecated. Retrieves storage size info per namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_getStorageSizes
methods.description: Retrieves storage sizes for all namespaces.

methods.name: endpoint_getNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Gets storage limit for a namespace.

methods.name: endpoint_setNamespaceStorageLimit
methods.description: Sets storage limit for a namespace.
